uncertain.reason: The maindeck's lands column extends below the bottom of the screenshot (cut off after Breeding Pool) and the sideboard panel is collapsed (shown only as a 'Sideboard: 3 Cards' label/button, its contents never rendered). I derived placement by elimination: the visible non-land maindeck grid accounts for 24 of the 40 picks, and exactly 13 of the remaining 16 picks are lands while exactly 3 (Balustrade Wurm, Nethergoyf, Tear Asunder) are non-lands. That 3-card remainder matches the explicit on-screen 'Sideboard: 3 Cards' count exactly, and the deck header's '41/40 Cards' matches 37 non-basic maindeck cards + 4 visible basics (Swamp x2, Forest x2). Both independent counts corroborate the split, but I never visually saw the sideboard's or the cut-off lands' actual card art.
